# Tan <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Math](Language-Features-Math)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Tan:Float32 degrees:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `degrees` | In | Float32 | required | The angle in degrees. |

**Returns:** The tangent.

## Description

Returns the tangent of an angle given in degrees, not radians.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print Tan(45)
```

```text
1.0
```
